notes: Confirmed live. Running './bin/zqk system whoami -test.dummy' executes without credentials, assigns identity ACC-TEST-HARNESS, and grants wildcard read:*, write:*, delete:*, and access:* permissions. The root cause is strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-test.") in production AuthMiddleware (cmd/zqk/app/auth_middleware.go:50). Critical severity stands: any untrusted CLI caller or agent can bypass all RBAC and namespace barriers by appending an unrecognized test flag. Not gold-plating; removing test backdoors from production auth paths is mandatory under OWASP ASVS V1.1.2 and NIST SP 800-218 PW.1.2. Evidence grade elevated to E3 upon adversarial verification.

notes: Confirmed in internal/cli/processor.go:140-143. When cmd.Context() lacks a SecurityContext, NewProcessor silently instantiates NewSystemSecurityContext() with admin role and global read/write/delete privileges. This fail-open fallback was recognized as a hazard in cmd/zqk/object/draft_sweep_auth.go:29, which had to inject an ad-hoc guard specifically to reject ACC-SYSTEM contexts. High severity stands: defaulting to superuser privileges violates least privilege and fail-closed architecture (NIST SP 800-53 AC-3, OWASP ASVS V4.1.1). Unbound contexts must resolve to an unauthenticated/guest context or fail closed. Evidence grade elevated to E3 upon adversarial verification.

notes: Confirmed in cmd/zqk/tray/tray.go:214-231 and pkg/validation/qa/signing.go:39-77. Verification loads .zqk/keystore/auditor.priv using NewAuditorSigner, generating a new private key on disk if missing. Loading or generating private keys during command verification inverts asymmetric cryptography (NIST SP 800-57 Part 1 Section 5.2). Furthermore, VerifyEntry checks only static manifest e.Argv (pkg/tray/security.go:154), while runRun executes fullArgv which appends runtime user/agent arguments. Combined with default tray entries bypassing verification, arbitrary privileged flags can be executed without signature invalidation. High severity stands. Evidence grade elevated to E3 upon adversarial verification.

notes: Confirmed in pkg/scheduler/handlers_run_wrapper_retry.go:624-641. When executing direct non-shell commands, the runner constructs an interpolated shell string '/bin/sh -c "ZQK_JOB_ID=... exec <cmd> <args>"' solely so the job ID appears in process listings. In execCmdStr, escapedCmd is unquoted in the format string ('%s exec %s'), introducing argument expansion hazards for commands with spaces or special characters. Moderate severity stands: replacing direct exec.Command execution with shell string formatting violates secure process execution idioms (OWASP ASVS V12.1.2) for purely cosmetic process table tagging.
